If no lexer can be found with the given name, it catches the `ClassNotFound` exception and returns `None`. This property exists to encapsulate the logic for obtaining a lexer, making the code cleaner and more maintainable. The property handles errors gracefully by returning `None` when no suitable lexer is found, thus avoiding runtime exceptions in other parts of the program that depend on this property.
